messages:
maria (on-call): noticed a big spike in node bootstrap failures, started getting paged by pagerduty about failed pods landing on new nodes

aj: saw that too, looks like image pulls for our cuda-enabled base images are timing out during init

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-342. Severity: P2. Affected service: node-provisioning / K8s cluster-autoscaler

maria (on-call): repro locally by spinning up a new node pool with instance template using `redwood/cuda-runtime:12-2026-03`. kubelet logs show repeated `context deadline exceeded` on `docker pull`

olivia: docker hub status shows partial degradations for large layer downloads, maybe rate limiting from the docker side? https://www.dockerstatus.example.com/updates

aj: confirming. `docker pull` hangs on layer 5/12 for multiple minutes then fails. other smaller images are fine.

maria (on-call): impact estimate? are existing nodes affected or just new node boots?

tomas: only new node provisioning so far. autoscaler retries, pods backlog increasing in scale-up windows. customer-facing services are degraded for a small subset where new pods were scheduled.

support-bot: flagging high-value customers with incidents opened: CUST-772, CUST-801. notified account teams.

aj: quick mitigation options I can think of:
- switch imagePullPolicy to IfNotPresent on canary Deploys to avoid fresh pulls
- use our internal ECR mirror for cuda images (mirror has last known-good digest)
- prewarm nodes with the image via a rolling instance-group update (pre-pull via user-data)
- fallback to an older smaller runtime image without heavy layers

maria (on-call): agree. priority: 1) enable internal mirror path for autoscaler/instance templates 2) set imagePullPolicy IfNotPresent for non-critical rollouts 3) increase pod slack to avoid immediate evictions

olivia: I can push an infra change to instance templates to point to `internal-registry.redwood/cuda-runtime@sha256:deadbeef` — mirror was recently synced, should have that digest.

infra-bot: Request logged: INFRA-1259 (update instance templates). ETA 15m for rollout across regions us-east1/us-west2

aj: while that's rolling, we should reduce cluster-autoscaler aggressiveness to delay scale-ups until mirror fully applied. Also patch the CA helm values to shorten exponential retries on pull failures.

maria (on-call): I'll take the on-call handoff when aj finishes CA change. @tomas please coordinate on customer comms.

tomas: drafting message to affected customers now — keep it transparent, mention Docker Hub large-layer disruptions and our mitigation steps.

olivia: rolling update started. snippet of the template change:```json
{
  "image": "internal-registry.redwood/cuda-runtime@sha256:deadbeef",
  "prePull": true
}
```

aj: patched cluster-autoscaler values and applied helm --wait. Reduced max surge and bumped scaleDownDelay.

maria (on-call): monitoring node join success. initial nodes in us-east1 now booted with image already present, kubelet shows `ImageFS pull complete` quickly.

sre-bot: Metric alert cleared: autoscaler-scaleups-failed (had 600 errors / 5m) -> now 0/5m

olivia: mirror rollout completed in us-west2 as well, verified pulls from mirror across both regions.

maria (on-call): starting controlled resume of normal autoscaling. will leave CA conservative for 30m to monitor.

support-bot: customer comms sent for CUST-772 and CUST-801. included RCA-in-progress and mitigation steps.

tomas: quick note for post-incident: add a pre-pull step in our golden AMI build for heavy GPU base images, and add a health-check in autoscaler to detect repeated pull timeouts and switch to mirror automatically.

aj: logs snippet from kubelet before fix:```
Mar 15 12:01:12 kubelet[1234]: pulling image redwood/cuda-runtime:12-2026-03
Mar 15 12:06:13 kubelet[1234]: failed to pull image: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded
```

maria (on-call): timeline: first alert 1763123456, mitigation (mirror switch) applied 1763123520, last verification 1763123620. Escalation closed for now but keeping on-call for the next hour.

sre-bot: Incident update: mitigation applied, monitoring ongoing. please file postmortem with proposed PREPULL/AMI changes and autoscaler mirror-fallback logic.

olivia: filing INFRA-1260 for AMI pre-pull and INFRA-1261 for autoscaler mirror fallback logic.
